quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets your body bend, like your elbows and knees. It is also the one found wherever two bones meet and move together!
quests.question: Joints
quests.hint: They let parts of your body bend!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Joints are the bendy parts, like elbows and knees, where two bones meet!
quests.funFact: Your joints are the reason your body can bend, twist, and fold!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is the name for all the bones in your body working together. It is also the one that gives your whole body its shape and lets you stand up!
quests.question: Skeleton
quests.hint: It is the name for ALL your bones together!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Skeleton is the name for all the bones in your body working together!
quests.funFact: Your skeleton is the name for every single bone in your body, all working as a team!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a thin bone connecting your shoulder to your chest. It is also the one found just below your neck, running side to side!
quests.question: Collarbone
quests.hint: It is just below your neck!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Collarbone is the thin bone below your neck that connects your shoulder to your chest!
quests.funFact: Your collarbone is one of the bones you can feel most easily under your skin!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a flat, triangle-shaped bone on your upper back. It is also the one that you can feel move under your skin when you shrug!
quests.question: Shoulder Blade
quests.hint: It is flat and shaped like a triangle!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shoulder Blade is the flat bone on your upper back that helps your arm swing!
quests.funFact: Your shoulder blade is shaped a bit like a triangle!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that feels soft and pink inside your mouth, holding your teeth in place. It is also the one that a dentist checks along with your teeth!
quests.question: Gums
quests.hint: They hold your teeth in place!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Gums are the soft pink part in your mouth that holds your teeth in place!
quests.funFact: Your gums hold every one of your teeth firmly in place!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a small, round bone at the front of your knee. It is also the one that protects your knee joint when you kneel down!
quests.question: Kneecap
quests.hint: It is a small, round bone on your knee!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Kneecap is the small round bone at the front of your knee that protects it!
quests.funFact: Your kneecap is not even fully bone yet when you are a baby, it hardens as you grow!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that protects your eyes from bright sunshine and dust -- it is also the one that closes gently every time you blink!
quests.question: Eyelids
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They close every time you blink!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Eyelids cover your eyes like tiny curtains and close every time you blink!
quests.funFact: Your eyelids blink automatically to keep your eyes clean and safe!

quests.instruction: Find the body part that forms the bottom of your foot and touches the ground first and touch it!
quests.question: Soles
quests.hint: Think about this: They touch the inside of your shoes.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Soles are the bottom of your feet that touch the ground!
quests.funFact: Your soles help you feel if the ground is smooth, bumpy, hot, or cold.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that has a hard bone right under a thin layer of skin -- it is also the one that forms the front of your leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.question: Shins
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the front of your lower legs!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Shins are the front of your lower leg, where the bone sits close to your skin!
quests.funFact: The bone in your shin is one of the strongest bones in your body!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that can be an 'innie' or an 'outie' -- it is also the one that forms a little round dot in the middle of your tummy!
quests.question: Belly Button
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the little dot in the middle of your tummy!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Belly Button is the little dot in the middle of your tummy that everybody has!
quests.funFact: Everybody has a belly button, and everybody's looks a little different!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found at the tip of your nose, one on each side -- it is also the one that forms two little openings at the bottom of your nose!
quests.question: Nostrils
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the two little holes in your nose!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Nostrils are the two small openings in your nose that air moves through!
quests.funFact: You actually breathe more through one nostril at a time, and they take turns!

quests.instruction: Show me the body part that helps your hand grip a crayon to draw!
quests.question: Thumbs
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It helps your hand grip things tightly.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: Your thumb can bend and touch each of your other fingers.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part you rest on your hand when you are thinking hard!
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is right below your lips.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Your chin helps give your face its own special shape.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part where you might wear a cozy bracelet or watch!
quests.question: Wrists
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You bend these to wave your hand.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: You use your wrists every time you turn a doorknob.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part that fills up with air when you take a big breath!
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It fills with air when you breathe in.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: A big, deep breath fills your whole chest with fresh air.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that forms the back of your leg, between your knee and your ankle and touch it!
quests.question: Calves
quests.hint: Think about this: They are between your knee and your ankle.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Calves are the back of your lower leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.funFact: Calves are the back part of your leg, below your knee.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that holds your brain safe inside, like a helmet made of bone!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Your hat goes right on top of it.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Your head makes up a big part of your whole body when you are a baby!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you use to ride a bicycle around the block!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: Your feet are found at the end of these.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: Your two legs work together perfectly every time you ride a bike!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to point at a pretty rainbow?
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: Hint: They are found at the end of your hands.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: You have ten fingers, and each one has its own fingerprint!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that keeps your head warm on a cold, snowy day!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: It grows longer if you do not cut it.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: You have about one hundred thousand hairs growing on your head!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets your head nod, shake, and turn around!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: You turn this to look behind you.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Your neck works hard to hold up your head all day long!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you shrug when you are not sure of the answer?
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Hint: You lift these up when you shrug.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Your shoulders let your arms swing all the way around!

quests.instruction: Find the body part that smiles big when you feel happy and proud. It is also the one you look at in the mirror every morning!
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: You see this when you look in a mirror!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Your face can make thousands of different expressions!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to give a warm, big hug?
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: Hint: You wave these to say goodbye.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: You use over thirty muscles just to bend and lift your arms!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to hear birds singing?
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: Hint: Your favorite song plays through these.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Your ears never stop listening, even while you sleep!

quests.instruction: Find the body part that lets you fold your arm to eat your dinner. It is also the one found halfway between your shoulder and your wrist!
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: They are the bendy part in the middle of your arm!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: Your elbows let your arms fold in half, like a hinge on a door!

quests.instruction: Find the body part that a grandparent might gently pinch to say hello. It is also the one that pushes up high on your face when you smile!
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: You have two, one on each side of your face!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Your cheeks puff up with air when you blow a big bubble.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that forms the round back part of your foot and touch it!
quests.question: Heels
quests.hint: Think about this: They are below your ankles, at the back.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Heels are the round back part of your feet that touch the ground first!
quests.funFact: Heels touch the ground first with almost every step you take.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that keeps your mouth closed when it is not talking. It is also the one you smack together after a tasty, sweet treat!
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: They curve up when you smile!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: Your lips are much more sensitive to touch than most of your skin!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to taste yummy strawberries?
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: Hint: You stick this out to taste snowflakes.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Your tongue has thousands of tiny taste buds on it!
